name: Taxon composition
description: Relative abundance composition from a long taxon profile table. Counts are converted to per-sample relative abundance, taxa on curation lists with the artifact role are removed and abundances renormalised, and the top_n taxa plus Other are drawn as stacked bars per sample (ordered by group, subject and timepoint when mapped). Also writes the long composition table and a per-taxon prevalence table.

inputs.label: Taxon profiles (long)
inputs.description: One row per taxon per sample with read counts, such as a MetaxPath sample profile or a Bracken report dataset.

top_n.title: Taxa to show
top_n.description: Number of most abundant taxa (by mean relative abundance) drawn individually; the rest is summed into Other.

min_relative_abundance_pct.title: Minimum relative abundance (%)
min_relative_abundance_pct.description: Taxon rows below this per-sample relative abundance are dropped from the composition table and counted as Other in the figure.

rank.title: Taxonomic rank
rank.description: When the table maps a rank role, keep only rows of this rank (falls back to the most frequent rank when absent). Leave empty to use every row.

outputs.name: composition_plot
outputs.description: Stacked relative abundance bars of the top taxa plus Other per sample.

outputs.name: composition
outputs.description: Long table of sample, taxon, count and renormalised relative abundance.

outputs.name: prevalence
outputs.description: Per taxon: prevalence, mean and maximum relative abundance, total reads.

citation: Built with pandas (McKinney 2010; The pandas development team, https://pandas.pydata.org), NumPy (Harris et al. 2020, https://numpy.org) and Plotly (Plotly Technologies Inc., https://plotly.com/python/). Artifact removal and renormalisation follow the INDIVO Explorer reference (microbiome()). See README.md for details.
